strike.subject_description: a huge gray stone golem king with aged gold crown and armor, red eyes, cyan crystals, blue-white leg shackles and short floor-anchored magical chains
strike.initial_pose: upright wide planted stance, arms hanging and complete fists beside knees
strike.description: One deliberate two-fist GROUND slam ending in the supplied bent-over pose. Lift both fists high for a heavy windup, then hinge the whole torso forward at the hips, lower head and shoulders, extend both elbows and strike the actual FLOOR in front of the planted feet with both complete knuckles. Finish low with both fists resting on the floor exactly as the final image. Keep ankles grounded, knees connected, hands and wrists solid and complete. Full-body coherent motion, intact armor and crystals throughout, no fading, dissolving, stippling, transparent holes, motion-smear, duplicated limbs, cropped hands, added particles or impact flashes. Fixed camera, size and view; leg magic remains attached.

recover.subject_description: a huge gray stone golem king with aged gold crown and armor, red eyes, cyan crystals, blue-white leg shackles and short floor-anchored magical chains
recover.initial_pose: deep forward bend with head and shoulders lowered, both complete fists resting on the floor before the feet
recover.description: Recover slowly from a grounded double-fist slam into the supplied upright idle. Lift BOTH complete fists off the floor, straighten the spine through the hips, raise chest/head together, and settle arms into their natural hanging pose. Knees remain connected to the hips and ankles, feet planted, leg shackles and floor chains attached. Smooth natural full-body articulation with intact stone, armor, crystals, hands and wrists throughout. No fading, dissolving, stippling, transparency holes, motion-smear, disconnected body parts, crop, camera movement, particles or new effects.
